method.reference: Installed UI/MiscData AOA304; independent fit at FOV30. Not gameplay camera verification.
method.uv: Every stored geoset and authored UV triangle, including animated texture IDs, with actual texture wrap axes. Stored LODs all included; render uses LOD0.
method.isolations: Diagnostic visibility and two-sided/unshaded materials. Sampled authored layers retained; first diffuse enabled only when all layers are hidden. Particle and ribbon draws suppressed on refreshed component diagnostics.
method.limitations: Renderer evidence, not in-game acceptance. Legacy emitters, popcorn systems and light-node behavior are not reproduced; missing textures and object-context replaceables are listed.
